components.name: Human / workload identity
components.description: User, IAM authenticator or ServiceAccount identity

components.name: Authentication
components.description: API server establishes who is making the request

components.name: Authorization
components.description: RBAC evaluates verbs, resources and scope

components.name: Admission
components.description: Policy validates or mutates an otherwise authorized request

components.name: RoleBinding
components.description: Grants role to subject in namespace or cluster scope

operational_steps: Authorize verb and resource with RBAC
Test allowed and denied API operations
failure_checkpoint: RBAC denies a required operation or grants excessive access
recovery_path: Use kubectl auth can-i and role review; grant the narrowest required verb/resource/scope.
